body.message:
As we operate as a holiday home provider from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, we can assist with check-in only within these operating hours.

Please also note that this building does not permit self-check-in. Therefore, we will need to arrange for one of our agents to be present and assist you with the check-in process.

For check-ins requiring an agent’s assistance, an additional AED 500 fee will apply.
